The named reruns prd-rerun, spine-rerun and epics-rerun each record the current parent stamp (line 2 equals the printed 'stamp for' value), though no grader of those cases checks it. Creates stamp too: resume, spine-answers and epics-from-spine pass their stamps-*-hash graders on the rebuilt files. Mechanism: lib/check.mjs:66-67 hashes raw bytes including the stamp line. Unit test '--stale reads a spine stale once the PRD it was built from takes a new stamp' passes.

truths.truth: A rerun over a stale link whose parent change touches nothing else in the document still records the new stamp, so the link reads fresh again and the change carries on down the chain (CONTEXT D-02; PLAN-4 must-be-true)
truths.evidence: The text is there: SKILL.md:497 ('A rerun records the current stamp even when nothing else in the file changes'), :855, :1173 and :1378, and docs/FORMAT.md:267. CONTEXT.md:16 makes it durable decision D-02, and CONTEXT.md:52 predicts the whitespace-edit rerun that changes only the stamp. No automated check exercises this path. Every kept rerun trace (prd-conflict-apply, stale-spine, stale-epics, prd-rerun, spine-rerun, epics-rerun) changes content as well as the stamp, and no case seeds a stale link whose parent change leaves the child's content alone. No grader or unit test can tell whether the model makes the stamp-only Edit or reports nothing to change and leaves the link stale, which would send every later bare /seldon back into the same rerun and never mark the next document stale.
